keys.manual_admin.tools.puntuacion.title: Scoring
keys.manual_admin.tools.puntuacion.desc: Configuration of times, points, and bonuses.
keys.manual_admin.tools.puntuacion.random_poi: Each game can draw every question’s point value from a range you define. A screen with the drawn value is shown before the question, and the timer does not start until that screen disappears.
It only affects Quiz and Word Scramble questions. Survey, Order, Matching, Numeric and Multiple Choice keep their usual scoring.
